policy: An exception is allowed only when no patched release exists or the vulnerable code path is provably unreachable. It must name a reason with the reachability proof and expire within 30 days; the loop fails the ratchet once it expires.

exceptions.reason: No patched release (latest 1.4.0). Only reachable through @parse/node-apn 8.1.0, which uses forge solely to parse our own APNs/PassKit PEM/PKCS#12 credentials (pem.decode, pkcs12FromAsn1, certificateFromAsn1, getPublicKeyFingerprint); it never verifies an untrusted RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 signature, the affected operation.
